module_wheels.maximum_rotation_difference_rear: Set maximum rotation difference between left or right wheel rotation and same axle rotation for limiting wheel radius calculation. Default value is 0.002 (0.2%). Setting higher difference value may result inaccurate wheel radius reading.
module_wheels.minimum_axle_rotation: Set minimum axle rotation (radians per second) for calculating wheel radius and differential locking percent. Default value is 4.
module_wheels.minimum_delta_distance: Set minimum recording distance (in meters) between each tyre wear sample. Default value is 5 meters. Lower value may result more samples recorded and bigger file size; higher value may result less samples recorded and inaccuracy. Recommended value range in 5 to 10 meters.
module_wheels.minimum_static_weight_override:
Manually set minimum static weight (in kilograms) excluding fuel, which overrides any estimated weight measurement. Set to -1 to disable override.

This option may be used if weight cannot be automatically measured or inaccurate due to lack of weight data from game API.
module_wheels.wheel_lift_off_threshold: Set millimeter threshold of tyre vertical deflection for detecting lifted wheels. Suspension travel is not calculated from wheel that is lifted off the ground (as below the threshold). Default threshold is 1 millimeter. Set to -1 to always calculate suspension travel even if wheel is lifted off.
module_wheels.wheel_lock_threshold: Set percentage threshold for counting wheel lock duration under braking. 0.3 means 30% of tyre slip ratio.

navigation.circle_outline_width: Set circle background outline width. Set value to 0 to hide outline.
navigation.fade_in_radius: Set fade in/out radius, value range in 0.0 to 1.0.
navigation.fade_out_radius: Set fade in/out radius, value range in 0.0 to 1.0.
navigation.show_background: Show background color that covers entire widget.
navigation.show_circle_vehicle_shape: Set True to show vehicle in circle shape, set False for arrow shape.
navigation.show_vehicle_standings: Show vehicle standings info on navigation map.
navigation.vehicle_offset: Set vehicle vertical position offset (percentage) relative to display size, value range in 0.0 to 1.0.
navigation.view_radius: Set viewable area by radius(unit meter). Default is 500 meters. Minimum value is limited to 5.

notification.notify_global_hotkey: Show notification while global hotkey is enabled.
notification.notify_locked_preset: Show notification for loading locked preset.
notification.notify_pace_notes_playback: Show notification while pace notes playback is enabled.
notification.notify_spectate_mode: Show notification while spectate mode is enabled.

onboard_setting.show_front_arb: Show current front anti-roll bar level.
onboard_setting.show_motor_map: Show current motor (or engine) map level.
onboard_setting.show_rear_arb: Show current rear anti-roll bar level.
onboard_setting.show_tc_cut: Show current TC power cut level.
onboard_setting.show_tc_slip: Show current TC slip angle level.

overlay.auto_hide: Check whether auto hide is enabled. This setting can be toggled from tray icon menu.
overlay.enable_grid_move: Enable grid-snap effect while moving widget for easy alignment and repositioning.
overlay.fixed_position: Check whether widget is locked at startup. This setting can be toggled from tray icon menu.
overlay.vr_compatibility:
Enable widget visibility as windows on taskbar in order to be used in VR via APPs such as OpenKneeboard. Non-VR user should not enable this option.

Note, you will still need a third party program (such as OpenKneeboard) to project overlay windows (widgets) into VR.

overlay_style.corner_radius_scale: Set bar corner radius, relative to shorter side of each bar. Value range in 0.0 to 0.5, 0 for square corners. Default is 0.05.
overlay_style.enable_depth_effects: Apply black box visual style to all widgets: lighter top, darker bottom and thin highlight edge on panels and bars, so they read as slightly raised. Elements smaller than 6 pixels stay flat. Default is enabled.
overlay_style.enable_modern_font: Replace default widget font with modern_font_name. Width of text bar is calculated from digit width to avoid clipping numbers. Default is enabled.
overlay_style.enable_modern_style: Enable modern overlay style: rounded corners, minimum gap between bars, fixed width digits, and auto font vertical offset that is independent of font leading. Default is enabled.
overlay_style.minimum_bar_gap: Set minimum gap between bars in pixels, only applies to widget bar_gap option that uses default value. Default is 2.
overlay_style.modern_font_name: Set modern font name. Default is JetBrains Mono, which is bundled with Modern Tiny Pedals (fonts folder), and works on all platforms. Ligatures are disabled.
overlay_style.overlay_theme:
Set overlay color theme, applied to default colors only (alpha channel is kept):

* Modern Dark: slate neutrals with softer accent colors (default). * High Contrast: darker backgrounds and brighter text, for bright rooms or VR. * Colorblind Safe: Okabe-Ito palette, red / green pairs become orange / blue. * Classic: original Modern Tiny Pedals colors.
overlay_style.widget_theme: Each widget has a widget_theme option. Global (default) uses overlay_theme; select any other theme (built-in or custom) to use it for this widget only, or Classic to keep classic colors on this widget.

pace_notes.comments_width: Set maximum display width, value in chars, such as 10 = 10 chars.
pace_notes.debugging_width: Set maximum display width, value in chars, such as 10 = 10 chars.
pace_notes.enable_auto_hide_if_not_available: Auto hide this widget if pace notes data is not available for current track.
pace_notes.enable_comments_line_break: Enable line break for displaying multi-line comments. To break a line into multiple lines, add \n to any part of the comment.
pace_notes.maximum_display_duration: Set maximum display duration (seconds) of each note. Set to -1 to always display notes. Default is -1.
pace_notes.pace_notes_width: Set maximum display width, value in chars, such as 10 = 10 chars.
pace_notes.pit_comments_text: Set custom notes and comments to be displayed while in pit lane.
pace_notes.pit_notes_text: Set custom notes and comments to be displayed while in pit lane.
pace_notes.show_background: Show background color. Turn off to show text only.
pace_notes.show_comments: Show nearest pace notes comments info behind current vehicle position.
pace_notes.show_debugging: Show nearest pace notes index number behind current vehicle position, and distance value (meters) behind current position to next index position.
pace_notes.show_pace_notes: Show nearest pace notes info behind current vehicle position.
pace_notes.show_pit_notes_while_in_pit: Show custom notes while in pit lane.

pedal.bar_length: Set pedal bar length and width in pixels.
pedal.bar_width_filtered: Set pedal bar length and width in pixels.
pedal.bar_width_unfiltered: Set pedal bar length and width in pixels.
pedal.enable_horizontal_style: Show pedal bar in horizontal style.
pedal.inner_gap: Set gap between pedal and maximum indicator.
pedal.maximum_indicator_height: This is the indicator height when pedal reaches maximum travel (100%), value in pixel.
pedal.readings_offset: Set reading text offset position (percentage), value range in 0.0 to 1.0.
pedal.show_*_filtered: Show filtered pedal input if available. Note, some vehicles may not provide filtered pedal input value, which the value will be zero. Disable this option to show raw input only.
pedal.show_brake_pressure: Show brake pressure changes applied on all wheels, which auto scales with maximum brake pressure and indicates amount brake released by ABS on all wheels. This option is enabled by default, which replaces game's filtered brake input that cannot show ABS.
pedal.show_readings: Show pedal input and force feedback readings. Note, while show_*_filtered option is enabled, only the highest reading between filtered and raw input is displayed.

pit_stop_estimate.actual_relative_refill: Show actual relative refilling, as the total additional fuel or virtual energy that will be added in next pit stop according to remaining fuel or virtual energy and user refill setting from MFD Pitstop page.
pit_stop_estimate.additional_pitstop_time: Set additional pit stop time that is not part of pass_duration or stop_duration. Default value is 2 seconds, which is the average time it takes to decelerate and accelerate towards and away from pit spot.
pit_stop_estimate.lengthy_stop_duration_threshold: Set warning threshold for lengthy pit stop duration in seconds. Default is 60 seconds. This option can be useful to check for unusually long pit stop duration, such as repairing.
pit_stop_estimate.minimum_total_duration: Show estimated minimum total pit time, which is the sum of pass_duration, stop_duration, and additional_pitstop_time. Note, this reading is recalculated only while not in pit lane.
pit_stop_estimate.pass_duration: Show estimated pit-lane pass through (drive-through) time, calculated from pit-entry to pit-exit line. Average accuracy is within 0.5 seconds. Note, for any new tracks, at least one pit-lane pass through is required to record data for pass through time calculation.
pit_stop_estimate.pit_occupancy: Show number of vehicles that stopped in pit lane, and number of vehicles currently in pit lane (whether passing or stopped). This does not include vehicles that are parked in garage.
pit_stop_estimate.pit_requests: Show number of vehicles that requested for pit stop, and number of vehicles currently outside pit lane.
pit_stop_estimate.pit_timer: Show pit timer, useful for comparing against other pit time readings.
pit_stop_estimate.show_estimated_laps_and_minutes: Show estimated total runnable laps and minutes after next pit stop according to refill setting from MFD Pitstop page. The estimation is calculated based on player's current consumption per lap and lap time pace. Useful for checking whether there will be enough fuel or energy added for the next stint and remaining time.
pit_stop_estimate.stop_duration:
Show estimated pit stop time while making a service stop or serving a penalty, calculated according to each setting from MFD Pitstop page and underlying service timing and concurrency differences. Average accuracy is within 1 seconds.

Note, for unscheduled pit stop (without requesting pit), game sometimes will add random amount extra delay (as part of pit crew preparation time) on top of pit stop time. To avoid this, always requests pit before entering pit.
pit_stop_estimate.stop_go_penalty_time: Set stop go penalty time in seconds. Default value is 10 seconds. Note, this value is only used if penalty time data is not available from game API.
pit_stop_estimate.total_relative_refill:
Show total relative refilling, as the total additional fuel or virtual energy that is required to finish the race. This is the same value as seen from refill column of Fuel Widget or Virtual energy Widget.

With both actual and total relative refilling readings, users can determine precisely how much fuel or virtual energy that will be added in next pit stop, and whether the refilling will be enough or more pit stops are required.

preset_keybinding.preset_*: Load assigned preset. Note, if assigned preset file is not found (such as deleted), it will not be loaded, and its name will be auto unassigned from list.

push_to_pass.activation_threshold_gear: Set minimum gear threshold for P2P ready indicator.
push_to_pass.activation_threshold_speed: Set minimum speed threshold for P2P ready indicator, unit in KPH.
push_to_pass.activation_threshold_throttle: Set minimum throttle input percentage threshold for P2P ready indicator, value range in 0.0 to 1.0. Default is 0.6 (60%).
push_to_pass.maximum_activation_time_per_lap: Set maximum P2P activation time per lap, unit in seconds.
push_to_pass.minimum_activation_time_delay: Set minimum time delay between each P2P activation, unit in seconds.
push_to_pass.show_activation_timer: Show electric boost motor activation timer.

radar.auto_hide_minimum_distance_ahead: The three values define an invisible rectangle area(unit meter) that auto hides radar if no vehicle is within the rectangle area. Default value is -1, which auto scales with radar_radius value. Set to any positive value to customize radar auto-hide range. Note, each value is measured from center of player's vehicle position.
radar.auto_hide_time_threshold: Set amount time(unit second) before triggering auto hide. Default is 1 second. Note, this option has no effect while enable_radar_fade is enabled.
radar.behind: The three values define an invisible rectangle area(unit meter) that auto hides radar if no vehicle is within the rectangle area. Default value is -1, which auto scales with radar_radius value. Set to any positive value to customize radar auto-hide range. Note, each value is measured from center of player's vehicle position.
radar.center_mark_radius: Set center mark size by radius(unit meter).
radar.center_mark_style: Set center mark line style. 0 for dashed line, 1 for solid line.
radar.center_mark_width: Set center mark line width in pixels.
radar.collision_course_critical_range_multipli: Set critical collision course detection range multiplier that scales with vehicle width. Default is 1.5 vehicle-wide.
radar.collision_course_minimum_speed_differenc: Set minimum speed difference (m/s) between you and opponent for displaying collision course. Default is 4 m/s.
radar.collision_course_nearby_range_multiplier: Set nearby collision course detection range multiplier that scales with vehicle width. A value of 4 would result a 4-vehicle-wide detection range. Default is 4 vehicle-wide.
radar.collision_course_speed_increment_per_met:
Set speed difference increment per meter for scaling speed difference threshold with the distance gap between you and opponent. Default is 0.5 m/s.

For example, a value of 0.5 (m/s) increment with a 15 meters distance gap would require at least 0.5 x 15 = 7.5 m/s speed difference between you and opponent to show collision course. Minimum speed difference is limited by collision_course_minimum_speed_difference option.
radar.distance_circle_*_radius: Set distance circle size by radius(unit meter). Circle will not be displayed if radius is bigger than radar_radius.
radar.distance_circle_*_style: Set distance circle line style. 0 for dashed line, 1 for solid line.
radar.distance_circle_*_width: Set distance circle line width in pixels.
radar.edge_fade_in_radius: Set fade in/out radius relative to radar radius, value range in 0.0 to 1.0.
radar.edge_fade_out_radius: Set fade in/out radius relative to radar radius, value range in 0.0 to 1.0.
radar.enable_auto_hide: Auto hides radar display when no nearby vehicles.
radar.enable_auto_hide_in_private_qualifying: Auto hides radar in private qualifying session, requires both enable_auto_hide and enable_restapi_access enabled.
radar.enable_radar_fade: Enable radar gradually fade in/out effect.
radar.global_scale: Sets global scale of radar display. Default is 6, which is 6 times of original size.
radar.indicator_size_multiplier: Set indicator size multiplier that scales with vehicle width.
radar.overlap_cone_angle: Set cone display angle in degrees. This option does not affect overlap detection range. Default is 120 degrees.
radar.overlap_critical_range_multiplier: Set nearby vehicle critical overlap detection range multiplier that scales with vehicle width. Default is 1 vehicle-wide.
radar.overlap_nearby_range_multiplier: Set nearby vehicle overlap detection range multiplier that scales with vehicle width. A value of 5 would result a 5-vehicle-wide detection range. Default is 5 vehicle-wide.
radar.radar_fade_in_radius: Set radar fade in radius relative to radar radius. Minimum value is limited to 0.1, maximum value cannot exceed radar_fade_out_radius. Default value is 0.8.
radar.radar_fade_out_radius: Set radar fade out radius relative to radar radius. Value range in 0.5 to 1.0. Default value is 0.98.
radar.radar_radius: Set the radar display area by radius(unit meter). Default is 30 meters. Minimum value is limited to 5.
radar.show_angle_mark: Show angle mark (fixed 45 degrees) on radar.
radar.show_background: Show background color that covers entire widget.
radar.show_collision_course: Show highlighted collision course from high speed approaching vehicle, or vehicle that caused yellow flag. Useful to quickly spot vehicle closing in at dangerous speed.
radar.show_distance_circle: Show distance circle line on radar for distance reference.
radar.show_overlap_indicator: Show overlap indicator when there are nearby side by side vehicles. This option shows boundary style indicator if show_overlap_indicator_in_cone_style option is disabled.
radar.show_overlap_indicator_in_cone_style: Show overlap indicator in cone style instead of boundary style.
radar.show_vehicle_orientation: Show opponent vehicle orientation (heading) relative to player. Disable this option to show player and opponent vehicle headings in parallel.
radar.side: The three values define an invisible rectangle area(unit meter) that auto hides radar if no vehicle is within the rectangle area. Default value is -1, which auto scales with radar_radius value. Set to any positive value to customize radar auto-hide range. Note, each value is measured from center of player's vehicle position.
radar.vehicle_length: Set vehicle overall size (length and width), value in meters.
radar.vehicle_maximum_visible_distance_ahead: The three values define an invisible rectangle area(unit meter) that hides any vehicle outside the rectangle area. Default value is -1, which auto scales with radar_radius value. Set to any positive value to customize vehicle visible range. Note, each value is measured from center of player's vehicle position.
radar.vehicle_width: Set vehicle overall size (length and width), value in meters.

rake_angle.rake_angle_smoothing_samples: Set number of samples for reducing data fluctuation. Lower value may result more fluctuated reading. Set 1 to disable smoothing.
rake_angle.show_degree_sign: Set true to show degree sign for rake angle value.
rake_angle.show_ride_height_difference: Show average front and rear ride height difference in millimeters.
rake_angle.wheelbase: Set wheelbase in millimeters. Default is 2800 millimeters. This option affects rake angle calculation accuracy.

relative.additional_players_behind: Set additional players shown on relative list. Each value is limited to a maximum of 60 additional players (for a total of 120 additional players). Default is 0.
relative.additional_players_front: Set additional players shown on relative list. Each value is limited to a maximum of 60 additional players (for a total of 120 additional players). Default is 0.
relative.brand_logo_width: Set maximum brand logo display width in pixels. Note, maximum brand logo display height is automatically adapted to font_size.
relative.class_width: Set class name display width, value is in chars, 4 = 4 chars wide. Set to 0 to hide class name while showing only class color.
relative.driver_name_align_center: Align driver name in the center when enabled. Default is left alignment when disabled.
relative.driver_name_shorten: Shorten driver's first name to a single letter with a period separating driver's last name, and any middle names will not be displayed. Note, if a driver is using nickname that consists only a single word, the name will not be shortened.
relative.driver_name_width: Set drive name display width, value in chars, such as 10 = 10 chars.
relative.finish_status_text: Set custom finish (checkered flag) status text which shows when driver finished race.
relative.font_color_laps_ahead: Set font color for lap difference. Note, font_color_laps_ahead and font_color_laps_behind applies to race session only.
relative.font_color_laps_behind: Set font color for lap difference. Note, font_color_laps_ahead and font_color_laps_behind applies to race session only.
relative.font_color_same_lap: Set font color for lap difference. Note, font_color_laps_ahead and font_color_laps_behind applies to race session only.
relative.garage_status_text: Set custom garage status text which shows when driver is in garage.
relative.nearest_time_gap_threshold_behind: Set nearest time gap threshold (in seconds) for opponent who is in front of or behind player. Default is 1 second for front, and 2 seconds for behind.
relative.nearest_time_gap_threshold_front: Set nearest time gap threshold (in seconds) for opponent who is in front of or behind player. Default is 1 second for front, and 2 seconds for behind.
relative.pit_status_text: Set custom pit status text which shows when driver is in pit.
relative.show_brand_logo: Show user-defined brand logo if available.
relative.show_class:
Show vehicle class categories. Class alias name and color are fully customizable in classes.json preset, see Vehicle Class Editor section for details.

Note, random color will be displayed for unknown class name that is not defined in classes.json preset.
relative.show_class_style_for_position_in_class: Show class style background color for position in class.
relative.show_compound_color_by_type:
Show different compound color by compound type, which can be customized in Tyre Compound Editor.

Note, player's compound color is not affected by this setting while show_player_highlighted option is enabled.
relative.show_compound_for_each_wheel:
Show tyre compound symbol for each wheel. Compound symbol display order is arranged as front left, front right, rear left, rear right. This option is enabled by default.

Disable this option to show a single symbol for all tyres, which allows a more compact view. If mixed tyres are used, a X symbol will be displayed instead, which can be customized by mixed_compound_symbol option.
relative.show_highlighted_fastest_last_laptime: Highlight the fastest last lap time within the same class if available.
relative.show_highlighted_nearest_time_gap: Show highlighted color on opponents within nearest time gap threshold.
relative.show_lap_difference: Show different font color based on lap difference between player and opponents. Note, this option will override font_color setting from position, driver name, vehicle name.
relative.show_laptime: Show driver's last lap time or pit stop duration if available. Invalid lap time is preceded by asterisk mark, such as *1:23.54.
relative.show_pit_request: Show pit request color indicator on pit stop count column.
relative.show_pit_status: Show indicator whether driver is currently in pit or garage, or causes yellow flag.
relative.show_pitstop_count: Show each driver's pit stop count and penalty count if available. Note, when a driver accumulates one or more penalties, this column will show the number of penalties in negative value with purple (default) background to distinguish from number of pit stops.
relative.show_pitstop_duration_while_requested_pi: Show driver's last recorded pit stop duration (in lap time column) while you have requested pit stop.
relative.show_player_highlighted: Highlight player row with customizable specific color.
relative.show_position_change: Show overall driver position change relative to overall qualification position.
relative.show_position_change_in_class: Show driver position change in class instead of overall. This option is enabled by default.
relative.show_position_in_class: Show driver's position standing in class.
relative.show_time_gap: Show relative time gap between player and opponents.
relative.show_time_gap_sign: Show plus or minus sign for time gap. - sign indicates opponent's relative position is in front of player, + sign indicates the opposite.
relative.show_tyre_compound: Show tyre compound symbol for tyre that matches specific tyre compounds defined in compounds.json preset.
relative.show_vehicle_brand_as_name: Show vehicle brand name instead of vehicle name. If brand name does not exist, vehicle name will be displayed instead.
relative.show_vehicle_in_garage: Show vehicles parked in garage stall. Default is false. Note, local player is always displayed.
relative.show_vehicle_name: Show vehicle name. Note, game API outputs skin livery name as vehicle name, which means actual displayed name depends on what skin livery name is called. For example, some vehicles may add team name and/or class name in skin livery name, some may not.
relative.time_gap_align_center: Align time gap in the center when enabled. Default is right alignment when disabled.
relative.time_gap_width: Set time gap display width, value is in chars, 5 = 5 chars wide.
relative.tyre_compound_spacing: Set display spacing (in pixels) between each compound symbol. Default is 1 pixel.
relative.vehicle_name_align_center: Align vehicle name in the center when enabled. Default is left alignment when disabled.
relative.vehicle_name_width: Set vehicle name display width, value in chars, such as 10 = 10 chars.
relative.yellow_flag_status_text: Set custom yellow flag status text which shows when driver causes (or likely to) yellow flag. Note, unlike in-game yellow flag, the indicator is always displayed when driver's speed is below 28kph (outside pit lane), regardless whether driver has caused yellow flag on track.

relative_finish_order.layout: 2 layouts are available: 0 = show columns from left to right, 1 = show columns from right to left.
relative_finish_order.near_finish_range: Set detection range (in seconds) near (before) start/finish line to show color indicator when vehicle is within the range (or less). Default is 20 seconds. Default color is orange.
relative_finish_order.near_start_range: Set detection range (in seconds) near (after) start/finish line to show color indicator when vehicle is within the range (or less). Default is 20 seconds. Default color is green.
relative_finish_order.number_of_extra_laps: Set number of extra laps for extra refilling calculation. Default is 1 extra lap.
relative_finish_order.number_of_prediction: Set number of optional prediction columns with customizable pit time. Value range in 0 to 10. Default is 4 extra customizable columns.
relative_finish_order.prediction_*_leader_pit_time: Set prediction pit time for leader or local player.
relative_finish_order.prediction_*_player_pit_time: Set prediction pit time for leader or local player.
relative_finish_order.show_absolute_refilling: Show absolute refilling value instead of relative refilling when enabled. Note, + or - sign is not displayed with absolute refilling.
relative_finish_order.show_extra_refilling:
Show readings of extra refilling row below local player's refilling row. Each extra refilling value equals extra laps of consumption plus local player's refilling value of same column. Those values save the trouble from manual calculation in case there will be extra laps.

The first column of extra refilling row shows number of extra laps depends on number of extra laps setting, such as EX+1 for 1 extra lap, or EX+3 for 3 extra laps.

ride_height.bottoming_height_*: Set bottoming ride height (in millimeters). This option is used for vehicle that hits ground before ride height reading reaches zero.
ride_height.ride_height_maximum_range: Set visualized maximum ride height display range (millimeter).

rivals.*_color_time_interval_ahead: Set custom time interval color of opponent ahead and behind.
rivals.*_color_time_interval_behind: Set custom time interval color of opponent ahead and behind.
rivals.time_interval_align_center: Align time interval in the center when enabled. Default is right alignment when disabled.

roll_angle.roll_angle_ratio_smoothing_samples: Set number of samples for reducing data fluctuation. Lower value may result more fluctuated reading. Set 1 to disable smoothing.
roll_angle.roll_angle_smoothing_samples: Set number of samples for reducing data fluctuation. Lower value may result more fluctuated reading. Set 1 to disable smoothing.
roll_angle.show_degree_and_percentage_sign: Set true to show degree and percentage sign.
roll_angle.show_roll_angle_difference: Show roll angle difference between front and rear roll angles.
roll_angle.show_roll_angle_ratio: Show roll angle ratio between front and rear. 50% indicates equal roll angle; less than 50% indicates rear rolls more than front.
roll_angle.wheel_track_front: Set front and rear wheel track in millimeters. Default is 1800 millimeters. This option affects roll angle calculation accuracy.
roll_angle.wheel_track_rear: Set front and rear wheel track in millimeters. Default is 1800 millimeters. This option affects roll angle calculation accuracy.

rpm_led.enable_double_side_led: Enable Outside to Center LED layout (as opposite to Left to Right layout). While this option is enabled, total number of LED is doubled.
rpm_led.led_height: Set LED width, height, radius in pixels. To achieve circle LED, set a higher radius value.
rpm_led.led_radius: Set LED width, height, radius in pixels. To achieve circle LED, set a higher radius value.
rpm_led.led_width: Set LED width, height, radius in pixels. To achieve circle LED, set a higher radius value.
rpm_led.number_of_led: Set number of LED to display. Minimum LED is limited to 3.
rpm_led.rpm_multiplier_critical: This value multiplies maximum RPM value, which sets critical range of RPM LED.
rpm_led.rpm_multiplier_low: This value multiplies maximum RPM value, which sets starting range of RPM LED.
rpm_led.rpm_multiplier_over_rev: This value multiplies maximum RPM value, which sets over rev range of RPM LED.
rpm_led.rpm_multiplier_redline: This value multiplies maximum RPM value, which sets redline range of RPM LED.
rpm_led.rpm_multiplier_safe: This value multiplies maximum RPM value, which sets safe range of RPM LED.
rpm_led.show_rpm_flickering_above_critical: Show flickering effects when RPM is above critical range and gear is lower than maximum gear.
rpm_led.show_speed_limiter_flash: Show RPM LED flash effect when speed limiter is activated.
rpm_led.speed_limiter_flash_interval: Set minimum time interval between each LED flash. Default is 0.25 seconds. Minimum value is limited to 0.2.

sectors.enable_all_time_best_sectors: Show sectors timing based on all time best sectors instead of current session. This option is enabled by default. Set false to show sectors timing from current session only.
sectors.extra_digits: Set extra digits for sector time display.
sectors.freeze_duration: Set freeze duration (seconds) for displaying previous sector time. Default is 5 seconds.
sectors.show_formatted_sector_time: Show sector time in minutes:seconds format. Disable this option to show sector time in seconds only.
sectors.target_laptime: Set target laptime for display target reference lap and sector time. Set Theoretical to show theoretical best sector time. Set Personal to show sector time from personal best lap time. Note, if enable_all_time_best_sectors option is enabled in Sectors Module, all time best sectors data will be displayed instead, otherwise only current session best sectors data will be displayed.

session.show_estimated_laps:
Show estimated total remaining laps (from current lap position towards finish line) based on total remaining session time and local player's lap time pace.

Note, this is the same value that used for calculating estimated refueling value in Fuel Module.

This reading does not concern about race leader's lap time pace, which means there may be an extra final lap on top of it. See show_predicted_extra_laps option below for extra laps prediction.
session.show_predicted_extra_laps:
Show number of more (or less) laps prediction on top of total estimated laps in race, based on leader's lap time pace and player's estimated pit stop duration.

Predicted extra laps reading is not added to the estimated laps reading, and is not taken into fuel calculation. Positive reading indicates there may be extra final laps on top of total estimated laps; negative reading indicates there may be less final laps on top of total estimated laps.

For example, a 12.45(+1) reading means there are 12.45 total estimated laps, plus 1 predicted final lap, which may result 12.45 + 1 = 13.45 final estimated laps.

Note, this option only works for time-based race type, and there is no guarantee…
session.show_session_name: Show current session name that includes testday, practice, qualify, warmup, race.
session.system_clock_format: Set clock format string. To show seconds, add %S, such as %H:%M:%S %p. See link for full list of format codes.

slip_angle.minimum_oversteer_slip_angle_difference:
Set minimum slip angle difference threshold (in degrees) for neutral steer, oversteer and understeer color indication.

Note, value should be set as negative angle for oversteer, and positive angle for understeer.
slip_angle.minimum_understeer_slip_angle_difference:
Set minimum slip angle difference threshold (in degrees) for neutral steer, oversteer and understeer color indication.

Note, value should be set as negative angle for oversteer, and positive angle for understeer.
slip_angle.slip_angle_maximum_range: Set visualized maximum slip angle display range (degrees). Default is 15 degrees.

slip_ratio.slip_ratio_maximum_range: Set visualized maximum slip ratio display range (percentage), value range in 10 to 100. Default is 50 percent.
slip_ratio.slip_ratio_optimal_range: Set optimal slip ratio range (percentage) for optimal and critical slip ratio color indication, value range in 0 to 100. Default is 30 percent.

speedometer.layout: 2 layouts are available: 0 = vertical layout, 1 = horizontal layout.
speedometer.off_throttle_threshold: Set throttle threshold which counts as off throttle if throttle position is lower, value range in 0.0 to 1.0. Default is 0.5.
speedometer.on_throttle_threshold: Set throttle threshold which counts as on throttle if throttle position is higher, value range in 0.0 to 1.0. Default is 0.01.
speedometer.show_speed_fastest: Show fastest recorded speed. To reset current record, shift gear into reverse, or reload preset.
speedometer.show_speed_maximum: Show maximum speed that is updated while on throttle.
speedometer.show_speed_minimum: Show minimum speed that is updated while off throttle.
speedometer.speed_maximum_reset_cooldown: Set cooldown duration (seconds) before resetting minimum or maximum speed value.
speedometer.speed_minimum_reset_cooldown: Set cooldown duration (seconds) before resetting minimum or maximum speed value.

standings.enable_multi_class_split_mode: Enable multi-class split mode, which splits and displays each vehicle class in separated groups. This mode will only take effect when there is more than one vehicle class present in a session, otherwise it will automatically fall back to normal single class mode.
standings.enable_single_class_exclusive_mode: Enable single-class exclusive mode, which displays vehicles from player's class only. This mode takes priority over all other display mode.
standings.energy_remaining_decimal_places: Set additional decimals to be displayed.
standings.incidents_extreme_threshold: Set threshold for showing color indication when number of incidents are equal or above.
standings.incidents_high_threshold: Set threshold for showing color indication when number of incidents are equal or above.
standings.lift_and_coast_highlight_threshold: Set minimum time threshold (in seconds) for highlighting lift and coast time. Default is 1 seconds.
standings.lift_and_coast_reset_threshold: Set time threshold (in seconds) for resetting recent recorded lift and coast time. Default is 60 seconds.
standings.maximum_vehicles_combined_mode: Set maximum amount vehicles to display in combined mode, which takes effect when enable_multi_class_split_mode is not enabled. When total vehicle number is lower than this value, extra rows will auto-hide. When total vehicle number is above this value, the top 3 vehicles will always show, and rest of the vehicles will be selected from the nearest front and behind places related to player.
standings.maximum_vehicles_exclusive_mode: Set maximum amount vehicles to display in exclusive mode, which takes effect when enable_single_class_exclusive_mode is enabled.
standings.maximum_vehicles_per_split_others: Set maximum amount vehicles to display for classes where player is not in. Default is 3.
standings.maximum_vehicles_per_split_player: Set maximum amount vehicles to display for class where player is in. Default is 7. Note that, if player is not in first place, then at least one opponent ahead of player will always be displayed, even if this value sets lower.
standings.maximum_vehicles_split_mode: Set maximum amount vehicles to display in split mode, which takes effect when in multi-class session and enable_multi_class_split_mode is enabled. If total vehicle number is above this value, any extra vehicles will not be shown. Default is 50, which is sufficient in most case.
standings.minimum_top_vehicles: Set minimum amount top place vehicles to display. This value has higher priority over other maximum_vehicles settings. Default is 3, which always shows top 3 vehicles if present.
standings.number_of_delta_laptime: Set number of delta lap time records to display. Minimum number is limited to 2, maximum is limited to 5.
standings.show_average_laptime: Show driver's average lap time calculated from (five) most recent laps.
standings.show_best_laptime: Show driver's session best lap time.
standings.show_best_laptime_from_recent_laps_in_ra: Show driver's best lap time from (five) most recent laps in race session. This option provides a better view of driver's recent performance during longer race.
standings.show_delta_laptime:
Show lap time difference (delta) between player and opponents from most recent laps (up to 5 recent lap time records). The default layout order shows delta lap time records from right side column (most recent lap) to left.

A green color (default) delta indicates that player's recent lap time is faster than opponent, while orange color delta indicates the opposite.
standings.show_energy_remaining:
Show remaining virtual energy reading in percentage from each driver, with 4 different states: - Unavailable: virtual energy reading is not available currently, default color grey. - High: above 30% remaining, default color green. - low: from 30% to 10% remaining, default color orange. - critical: 10% or lower remaining, default color red.

Note, for vehicle without virtual energy, remaining fuel (only if available) will be displayed instead. If fuel data is not available from game API, then nothing will be displayed.
standings.show_incidents:
Show total number of incidents for each driver from current session. This option helps tracking opponent's safeness and cleanness during long race. This option only works for LMU.

Note, incidents are counted from vehicle contacts and track cuts only for each individual driver. Incidents are not counted towards team. Incidents are only counted while this APP is running, and reset if changed session or restarted this APP.
standings.show_inverted_delta_laptime_layout: Enable this option to invert layout order for delta lap time records.
standings.show_laptime:
Show driver's last lap time or pit stop duration if available. Invalid lap time is preceded by asterisk mark, such as *1:23.54.

Note, if show_best_laptime is not enabled, this option will show driver's session best lap time in none-race sessions.
standings.show_lift_and_coast_time: Show most recent recorded lift and coast time (in seconds) from each driver.
standings.show_speed_trap:
Show fastest recorded speed of each driver per lap at user-defined speed trap position on track. This option can be useful to keep track of each driver's straight line performance from most recent lap.

Note, speed trap position is defined in tracks.json preset, which can be customized via Track Info Editor. Default speed trap position is set at start/finish line.
standings.show_stint_laps: Show number of completed laps from current stint and estimated total stint laps. Note, it may require a few laps to get accurate estimate.
standings.show_time_gap: Show each driver's time gap behind overall leader in race session. In none race sessions, time gap is calculated from overall leader's session best lap time.
standings.show_time_gap_from_same_class: Show time gap from same class leader instead of overall leader. This option only takes effect while enable_multi_class_split_mode is enabled.
standings.show_time_interval: Show time interval between each closest driver in order.
standings.show_time_interval_from_same_class: Show time interval from same class. This option only takes effect while enable_multi_class_split_mode is enabled.
standings.show_vehicle_integrity:
Show opponent vehicle integrity reading.

The integrity reading is calculated from hull damage, detachable wheels and parts, and displayed as: - Full integrity (no damage), as - (default color grey). - High integrity (lightly damaged hull), from 9 to 5 (default color blue). - Low integrity (severely damaged hull, and most likely has detached wheels or parts), from 4 to 0 (default color red).
standings.split_gap: Set split gap between each class.
standings.time_gap_leader_text: Set text indicator for race leader in time gap column.
standings.time_interval_leader_text: Set text indicator for race leader in time interval column.

steering_angle.manual_steering_range: Manually set steering display range in degrees. Set to 0 to read physical steering range from API. This option may be useful when steering range value is not provided by some vehicles.
steering_angle.minimum_oversteer_slip_angle_difference:
Set minimum slip angle difference threshold (in degrees) for neutral steer, oversteer and understeer color indication.

Note, value should be set as negative angle for oversteer, and positive angle for understeer.
steering_angle.minimum_understeer_slip_angle_difference:
Set minimum slip angle difference threshold (in degrees) for neutral steer, oversteer and understeer color indication.

Note, value should be set as negative angle for oversteer, and positive angle for understeer.
steering_angle.show_ackermann_percentage: Show Ackermann percentage of inner and outer wheel angle during cornering. 0 percent indicates parallel steering. 100 percent indicates true Ackermann steering. Negative percent indicates Anti-Ackermann steering.
steering_angle.show_front_wheel_angle: Show average front wheel angle in degrees.
steering_angle.show_inverted_yaw_rate_sign: Show inverted plus and minus signs for yaw rate. This option is disabled by default.
steering_angle.show_slip_angle_difference:
Show slip angle difference (in degrees) between average front and rear slip angle, with neutral steer, oversteer and understeer color indication.

Positive reading indicates understeer tendency (default orange color). Negative reading indicates oversteer tendency (default blue color). Reading close to zero indicates neutral steer (default white color).
steering_angle.show_steering_ratio: Show steering ratio between steering wheel angle and average front wheel angle.
steering_angle.show_turning_radius:
Show turning radius based on front wheel angle (average of left and right front wheel).

Note, this value does not take account of slip angle effect, which can be different from, or in extreme case, opposite of actual turning radius that affected by slip angle, such as during counter steering.
steering_angle.show_turning_radius_under_slip_angle: Show turning radius affected by slip angle.
steering_angle.show_yaw_rate: Show yaw rate (angular velocity) in degrees per second.
steering_angle.wheel_track_front: Set front wheel track in millimeters. Default is 1800 millimeters. This option affects Ackermann percentage calculation accuracy.
steering_angle.wheelbase: Set wheelbase in millimeters. Default is 2800 millimeters. This option affects Ackermann percentage and turning radius calculation accuracy.

steering_meter.bar_edge_width: Set left and right edge boundary width.
steering_meter.bar_height: Set steering meter bar width and height in pixels.
steering_meter.bar_width: Set steering meter bar width and height in pixels.
steering_meter.manual_steering_range: Manually set steering display range in degrees. Set to 0 to read physical steering range from API. This option may be useful when steering range value is not provided by some vehicles.
steering_meter.scale_mark_degree: Set gap between each scale mark in degrees. Default is 90 degrees. Minimum value is limited to 10 degrees.
steering_meter.show_scale_mark: This enables scale marks on steering meter bar.

steering_wheel.custom_steering_wheel_image_file:
Set custom steering wheel image file path. Double-click this option in widget's Config dialog to select an image file.

Note, image file must be in PNG format with same width and height. Maximum supported PNG file size is limited to 10MB. Default image will be used if selected image is not valid.
steering_wheel.display_margin: Set widget display margin in pixels.
steering_wheel.display_size: Set widget display size in pixels.
steering_wheel.manual_steering_range: Manually set steering display range in degrees. Set to 0 to read physical steering range from API. This option may be useful when steering range value is not provided by some vehicles.
steering_wheel.show_custom_steering_wheel: Show user-defined custom steering wheel image instead of default image.
steering_wheel.show_rotation_line: Show steering rotation reference line, which can be useful to see if physical steering wheel is misaligned.
steering_wheel.show_rotation_line_while_stationary_only: Show rotation line only while vehicle is stationary (less than 1m/s).

stint_history.layout: 2 layouts are available: 0 = vertical layout, 1 = reversed vertical layout.
stint_history.show_consistency: Show lap time consistency (percent) between stint best and stint average non-best lap time. Note, pit-in and pit-out laps are excluded from calculation.
stint_history.show_delta: Show lap time delta between stint best and stint average non-best lap time. Note, pit-in and pit-out laps are excluded from calculation.
stint_history.show_empty_history: Show empty stint history. Default is false, which hides empty rows.
stint_history.show_fuel: Show total fuel (or virtual energy) consumption in the stint.
stint_history.show_fuel_sign: Show fuel (or virtual energy) unit sign. L for liter, G for Gallon, E for virtual energy.
stint_history.show_laps: Show number of completed laps in the stint.
stint_history.show_time: Show total driving time in the stint.
stint_history.show_tyre: Show tyre compound used in the stint.
stint_history.show_virtual_energy_if_available: Show virtual energy consumption instead of fuel consumption if available. This option is enabled by default.
stint_history.show_wear: Show total average tyre wear (percent) in the stint.
stint_history.stint_history_count: Set the number of stint history display. Default is to show 2 most recent stints.

suspension_force.show_force_ratio: Show percentage force ratio between each and total suspension force. Set false to show individual suspension force in Newtons.

suspension_position.position_maximum_range: Set visualized maximum display range of suspension position (millimeter).
suspension_position.show_maximum_position_range:
Show a visualized line indicating maximum suspension position range under compression, which can be useful to check suspension travel limits. While this option enabled, the suspension position line will also change its color to match maximum_position_range_color when reaching maximum position. The visualized line will not be displayed if maximum position range is negative (such as with too much packers).

Note, maximum suspension position calculation is handled by Wheels Module, and resets after exited garage. A minimum of two laps are required to get sensible readings.
suspension_position.show_third_spring_position_mark: Show front and rear third spring position mark relative to each suspension position.

suspension_travel.show_bump_travel: Show bump travel (millimeter) between static and maximum recorded suspension position. Note, bump travel may not be available if static suspension position was not recorded.
suspension_travel.show_live_position_relative_to_static_po: Show current suspension position (millimeter) relative to static position instead.
suspension_travel.show_maximum_position: Show maximum recorded suspension position (millimeter) where suspension is reaching its maximum compression.
suspension_travel.show_minimum_position: Show minimum recorded suspension position (millimeter) where suspension is reaching its maximum extension.
suspension_travel.show_motion_ratio: Show estimated motion ratio between suspension and wheel travel. Note, the accuracy depends on game API data, and may not be available on certain vehicles.
suspension_travel.show_rebound_travel: Show rebound travel (millimeter) between static and minimum recorded suspension position. Note, rebound travel may not be available if static suspension position was not recorded.
suspension_travel.show_total_travel: Show total travel (millimeter) between minimum and maximum recorded suspension position.
suspension_travel.show_travel_ratio: Show travel ratio (percentage) between bump travel and total travel. For example, a 70% reading indicates 70% of travel is spent in bump, and 30% of travel in rebound. A 50% reading indicates equal travel in bump and rebound travel.

system_performance.average_samples: Set number of samples for average CPU utilization calculation. Lower value may result more fluctuated reading. Set 1 to disable averaging.
system_performance.show_system_performance: Show system's overall CPU utilization (percent) and memory usage (GB). Note, sampling interval is determined by update_interval setting.
system_performance.show_tinypedal_performance: Show Modern Tiny Pedals's CPU utilization (percent) and memory usage (MB).

timing.layout: 2 layouts are available: 0 = vertical layout, 1 = horizontal layout.
timing.show_average_pace: Show personal current average lap time pace, this reading is also used in real-time fuel calculation. Note, additional average lap time pace calculation setting can be found in Delta Module config. After ESC or session ended, lap time pace reading will be reset, and aligned to all time personal best lap time if available.
timing.show_best: Show personal all time best lap time.
timing.show_estimated: Show personal current estimated lap time.
timing.show_session_best: Show current session best lap time from all vehicle classes.
timing.show_session_best_from_same_class_only: Show current session best lap time from same vehicle class only.
timing.show_session_personal_best: Show personal current session best lap time.
timing.show_stint_best: Show personal current stint best lap time.

track_clock.enable_time_scaled_countdown: Enable time scaled countdown, which scales with session track clock time scale multiplier. This option is disabled by default.
track_clock.enable_track_clock_synchronization:
Enable auto track clock and time scale synchronization. enable_restapi_access must be enabled to synchronize track clock from Rest API.

Note, synchronization may not work in multiplayer.
track_clock.show_sunlight_phase_countdown:
Show sunlight phase countdown timer and indicator. The timer counts down towards each of four primary sunlight phases: sunrise, midday, sunset, midnight. An arrow indicator is displayed alongside with day/night color.

This countdown timer can be used to check how long until sunrise or sunset for planning strategy.

Note, game does not provide sunrise and sunset data. Sunrise and sunset hours must be manually defined in Track Info Editor to get correct readings.

See Wiki Appendix page for sunrise and sunset reference table for some common tracks.
track_clock.show_time_scale: Show current session track clock time scale multiplier.
track_clock.show_track_clock: Show current in-game clock time of the circuit.
track_clock.track_clock_format: Set track clock format string. To show seconds, add %S, such as %H:%M:%S %p. See link for full list of format codes.
track_clock.track_clock_time_scale: Manually set time multiplier for time-scaled session. Default is 1, which matches Time Scale: Normal setting in-game. Note, this option will only be used if enable_track_clock_synchronization option is disabled.

track_map.auto_prediction_additional_pitstop_time: Set additional pit stop time it takes to decelerate and accelerate towards and away from pit spot. This option corresponds to additional_pitstop_time option from Pit stop estimate Widget, and both should be set to same amount. Default value is 2 seconds.
track_map.display_detail_level: Sets detail level for track map. Default value is 1, which auto adjusts map detail according to display size. Higher value reduces map detail and RAM usage, and may also help reduce rough edges from large map. Set to 0 for full detail.
track_map.display_orientation: Set track map display orientation in degrees. For example, a 270 value will rotate map by 270 degrees clockwise. Default value is 0, which always displays track map North Up in game's coordinate system.
track_map.enable_auto_pitout_prediction:
Show auto-estimated pit-out duration prediction. Default indication shows as a green circle. This option does not count towards number_of_prediction limit.

Auto estimated pit-out duration is calculated in the same way as Pit Stop Estimate Widget.

Note, this option only works for LMU, and enable_restapi_access must be enabled in LMU API setting.
track_map.enable_fixed_pitout_prediction:
Show pit-out prediction based on user-defined fixed pitstop duration instead. This option overrides pitout_duration_minimum and pitout_duration_increment options.

While this option is enabled, total pit-out duration is calculated from the sum of pit-out time offset, fixed pit stop duration and estimated pit lane pass-through duration. It's required to enter and exit pit lane at least once to get correct total pit-out duration.
track_map.enable_multi_class_styling:
Show vehicles in multi-class color styles on map instead. Multi-class color can be customized from Vehicle Class Editor.

Note, while multi-class styling is enabled, following color styles will not be displayed: vehicle_color_player, vehicle_color_leader, vehicle_color_same_lap, vehicle_color_laps_ahead, vehicle_color_laps_behind.
track_map.fixed_pitstop_duration: Set fixed amount pit stop duration (in seconds). Note, only stopped time should be considered for this option. Set to 0 if only passing through pit lane (such as Drive Through). Set to -1 to disable this option.
track_map.number_of_prediction: Set number of pit-out prediction to display. Value range is limited in 1 to 20.
track_map.pitout_duration_increment:
Set each pit stop duration (in seconds) increment after previous prediction. Default increment is 10 seconds. This option has no effect if enable_fixed_pitout_prediction is enabled.

Note, each time when pit stop duration of the nearest prediction exceeded current pit stop timer, the prediction circle will be removed, and a new prediction circle will be appended with pit stop duration increment after the last prediction.
track_map.pitout_duration_minimum: Set pit stop duration (in seconds) of first prediction. This option has no effect if enable_fixed_pitout_prediction is enabled.
track_map.pitout_time_offset:
Set amount time offset (in seconds) for catching up with vehicle speed after pit-out. Default is 3 seconds.

Note, this value is important for accurate prediction, as initial vehicle speed is much slower after pit-out, so extra time is needed for driver to catch up, and also affected by pit-out line location. For most tracks, this extra time after pit-out is roughly within 1 to 5 seconds.
track_map.proximity_circle_radius: Set proximity circle radius in meters. Default radius is 150 meters.
track_map.safety_car_text: Set custom text for safety car. Default is SC.
track_map.show_custom_player_color_in_multi_class: Show custom player vehicle color (defined in vehicle_color_player option) while enable_multi_class_styling option is enabled.
track_map.show_lap_difference_outline: Show outline color based on lap difference (ahead or behind) between player and opponents. This option is disabled by default.
track_map.show_map_background: Show background of the inner map area. This option only works for circular type tracks.
track_map.show_pitout_prediction:
Show estimated pit-out on-track position indication for each pit stop duration. Default indication shows circle with pit stop duration displayed above.

Note, pit-out position prediction is based on delta best data which scaled with player's latest lap time pace for accurate real-time position prediction under various track conditions. Pit-out prediction requires both valid track map and delta best data to display. At least one valid lap for any car and track combo is required to display pit-out prediction.

For accurate prediction, the location of pit-out line must be found first. And since each track has different pit-out line location, it is required to pit-out at least once per session…
track_map.show_pitout_prediction_while_requested_p: Show estimated pit-out on-track position indication while player has requested pit stop and not in pit lane.
track_map.show_pitstop_duration: Show pit stop duration reading on top of each prediction circle.
track_map.show_position_in_class: Show position in class while enable_multi_class_styling option is also enabled, otherwise this option has no effect.
track_map.show_proximity_circle: Show proximity circle around player's position, which helps to quickly spot player and nearby opponents on map.
track_map.show_safety_car:
Show safety car position on map if available. This option currently only works in RF2.

Note, safety car position data from RF2 API is fairly limited, and has a very low update rate, in order to workaround API limitation, safety car position data is interpolated to display smoothly, but may still desync occasionally.
track_map.show_vehicle_standings: Show vehicle standings info on track map. Note, if enable_multi_class_styling is enabled, position in class will be displayed for each vehicle class instead.
track_map.vehicle_scale: Set vehicle scale that multiplies base vehicle size. Note, base vehicle size is determined by font size and bar padding. Minimum scale is limited to 1.0.
track_map.vehicle_scale_player: Set vehicle scale that multiplies base vehicle size. Note, base vehicle size is determined by font size and bar padding. Minimum scale is limited to 1.0.
track_map.vehicle_scale_safety_car: Set vehicle scale that multiplies base vehicle size. Note, base vehicle size is determined by font size and bar padding. Minimum scale is limited to 1.0.

track_map_viewer.curve_grade_*: Set corner curve classification by radius (meters). Set value to -1 to exclude from grade selection.
track_map_viewer.inner_margin: Set inner margin for info display.
track_map_viewer.length_grade_*: Set corner length classification by meters.
track_map_viewer.position_increment_step: Set single increment step for position slider and spin box. Default is 5 meters.
track_map_viewer.slope_grade_*: Set road slope classification by slope percent.

track_notes.comments_width: Set maximum display width, value in chars, such as 10 = 10 chars.
track_notes.debugging_width: Set maximum display width, value in chars, such as 10 = 10 chars.
track_notes.enable_auto_hide_if_not_available: Auto hide this widget if track notes data is not available for current track.
track_notes.enable_comments_line_break: Enable line break for displaying multi-line comments. To break a line into multiple lines, add \n to any part of the comment.
track_notes.maximum_display_duration: Set maximum display duration (seconds) of each note. Set to -1 to always display notes. Default is -1.
track_notes.pit_comments_text: Set custom notes and comments to be displayed while in pit lane.
track_notes.pit_notes_text: Set custom notes and comments to be displayed while in pit lane.
track_notes.show_background: Show background color. Turn off to show text only.
track_notes.show_comments: Show nearest track notes comments info behind current vehicle position.
track_notes.show_debugging: Show nearest track notes index number behind current vehicle position, and distance value (meters) behind current position to next index position.
track_notes.show_pit_notes_while_in_pit: Show custom notes while in pit lane.
track_notes.show_track_notes: Show nearest track notes info behind current vehicle position.
track_notes.track_notes_uppercase: Set track notes text to uppercase.
track_notes.track_notes_width: Set maximum display width, value in chars, such as 10 = 10 chars.

traffic.bar_width: Set each column width, value in chars, such as 10 = 10 chars. Default is 6. Minimum width is limited to 3.
traffic.enable_traffic_highlight_from_current_la: Highlight traffic vehicles that can potentially overtake or be overtaken from current lap, which is useful to determine fuel saving strategy.
traffic.show_driver_name_instead_of_class: Show driver name instead of class name.
traffic.show_estimated_laps:
Show estimated laps towards nearest reachable traffic vehicles. Note, it may take 1 or more laps to get accurate estimates.

For example, a 2.34L value from faster column indicates the amount laps it would take for the faster vehicle that behind you to catch up with you; while same value from slower column indicates the amount laps it would take for you to catch up with the slower vehicle ahead.
traffic.show_faster_behind: Show column for nearest reachable faster vehicle relatively from behind.
traffic.show_race_leader: Show column for race leader relatively from behind.
traffic.show_slower_ahead: Show column for nearest reachable slower vehicle relatively ahead.
traffic.show_time_interval: Show time interval between you and traffic vehicles.

trailing.*_line_style: Set trailing line style. 0 for solid line, 1 for dashed line.
trailing.*_line_width: Set trailing line width in pixels.
trailing.display_height: Set pedal plot display height in pixels.
trailing.display_margin: Set pedal plot display margin (vertical relative to pedal) in pixels.
trailing.display_order_*: Set display order of plot lines.
trailing.display_scale:
Set plot display scale. Default scale is 2. Minimum scale is limited to 1.

Note, when high DPI scaling mode is enabled on high resolution (2k or 4k) screen, the widget base size will also be scaled up according to system's DPI setting, which may result larger plot even when display_scale is set to 1. If smaller plot size is preferred, manually disable high DPI scaling mode via Scale button on main window status bar.
trailing.display_width: Set pedal plot display width in pixels.
trailing.maximum_paused_frames:
Set maximum number of paused frames to keep plotting. This option is disabled by default.

Set value to 1 or higher will keep plotting for maximum number of frames while game data desynced or stopped updating. Set to 0 to disable this option, which plots only when data synced. Note, it's generally not required to enable this option.
trailing.maximum_slip_angle_difference: Set maximum display range (in degrees) for slip angle difference plot. Default is 5 degrees.
trailing.reference_line_*_offset: Set reference line vertical offset position (percentage) relative to pedal, value range in 0.0 to 1.0.
trailing.reference_line_*_style: Set reference line style. 0 for solid line, 1 for dashed line.
trailing.reference_line_*_width: Set reference line width in pixels. Set value to 0 to hide line.
trailing.show_abs_activation: Show ABS activation plot, which overlaps brake plot when active.
trailing.show_absolute_ffb: Convert force feedback value to absolute value before plotting. Set to false to show force feedback plot in both positive and negative range.
trailing.show_slip_angle_difference: Show slip angle difference plot (difference between average front and rear slip angle). Plot line that draws above the center reference line indicates understeer tendency; while below the center reference line indicates oversteer tendency.
trailing.show_speed:
Show speed plot relative to player's top reference speed from current stint.

Note, at least one lap is required to calibrate top reference speed. Top reference speed resets when vehicle stopped on track.
trailing.show_tc_activation: Show TC activation plot, which overlaps throttle plot when active.
trailing.show_throttle: Show filtered throttle plot. Note, some vehicles may not provide filtered pedal input value, which the value will be zero.
trailing.show_wheel_lock: Show wheel lock (slip ratio) plot under braking when slip ratio has exceeded wheel_lock_threshold value.
trailing.show_wheel_slip: Show wheel slip (slip ratio) plot under acceleration when slip ratio has exceeded wheel_slip_threshold value.
trailing.time_scale:
Set plot time scale. When time scale is 1 (default), plot will be synchronized with update_interval.

Note, value less than 1 draws plot slower; higher than 1 draws plot faster. Setting this value too high or too low may result plot stuttering.

trailing.wheel_slip_threshold: Set percentage threshold for triggering wheel slip warning under acceleration. 0.1 means 10% of tyre slip ratio.

tyre_pressure.hot_pressure_temperature_threshold: Set minimum temperature threshold (measured from tyre carcass in Celsius) for hot pressure indication. Default is 65 degrees Celsius. Default color for cold pressure is blue, and orange for hot pressure.
tyre_pressure.show_compound_color_by_type: Show different compound color by compound type, which can be customized in Tyre Compound Editor.

tyre_pressure.show_tyre_compound: Show tyre compound symbols (front and rear) that matches specific tyre compounds defined in compounds.json preset.
tyre_pressure.swap_style: Swap cold and hot pressure color.

tyre_temperature.show_degree_sign: Set true to show degree sign for each temperature value.
tyre_temperature.show_inner_center_outer: Set inner, center, outer temperature display mode. Set false to show average temperature instead.

tyre_wear.layout: 2 layouts are available: 0 = vertical layout, 1 = horizontal layout.

Show estimated total remaining tyre tread at the end of current stint, which helps to determine whether there is enough tread for current or more stints. Negative reading indicates that there will not be enough tyre tread remaining at the end of current stint.

For example, if minimum safe tyre tread is around 10%, then for triple-stint tyre saving, aim for 70% remaining tread for first stint, 40% for second stint, and 10% for third stint.
tyre_wear.show_flat_spot: Show amount wear from flat spot due to wheel lock.
tyre_wear.show_lifespan_laps: Show estimated tyre lifespan in laps.
tyre_wear.show_lifespan_minutes: Show estimated tyre lifespan in minutes.
tyre_wear.show_live_wear_difference: Show current lap tyre wear difference.
tyre_wear.show_remaining: Show total remaining tyre tread in percentage that changes color according to wear.
tyre_wear.show_wear_difference: Show estimated tyre wear difference per lap (at least one valid lap is required).
tyre_wear.warning_threshold_laps: Set warning threshold for estimated tyre lifespan in laps. Default is 5 laps.
tyre_wear.warning_threshold_minutes: Set warning threshold for estimated tyre lifespan in minutes. Default is 5 laps.

tyre_wear.warning_threshold_wear: Set warning threshold for total amount tyre wear of last lap in percentage. Default is 3 percent.

units.power_unit: Available units: Kilowatt, Horsepower, Metric Horsepower.

virtual_energy.*fuel_bias:
Show fuel bias (unit in laps) that calculated from estimated laps difference between fuel and virtual energy.

Positive value indicates more laps can be run on fuel than virtual energy; in other words, virtual energy will deplete sooner than fuel. For example, a value of +1.5 indicates that there will be 1.5 laps of extra fuel remaining after virtual energy depleted.

Note, depleting virtual energy could result a Stop-Go penalty in LMU; while running out of fuel means no power for vehicle and would result retirement from race. So it is a good idea to keep fuel bias close to 0.0, and slightly towards positive side to avoid depleting fuel before virtual energy.
virtual_energy.*fuel_ratio: Show fuel ratio between estimated fuel and energy consumption, which can help balance fuel and energy usage, as well as providing refueling reference for adjusting pit stop Fuel ratio during race.
virtual_energy.show_absolute_refilling: Show absolute refilling value instead of relative refilling when enabled. Note, + or - sign is not displayed with absolute refilling.
virtual_energy.show_fuel_ratio_and_bias: Show fuel ratio and fuel bias column.

weather.decimal_places_temperature: Set amount decimal places to keep. Default is 1 decimal place, set to 0 to hide decimals. Note, when number of digits is less than expected, extra leading zero or decimal place will be added to fill the gap.
weather.raininess_trend_interval:
Set weather change trend interval in seconds. Default interval is 60 seconds.

If weather readings increased within the interval, ▲ uparrow sign will be shown; if readings decreased within the interval, ▼ downarrow sign will be shown; If readings has not changed during the interval, ● sign will be shown after.
weather.rubber_median_laps: Set median laps at the point when grip becomes Heavy (High) for calculating accurate rubber coverage. Default median laps is 2000. This value may vary from different games, see above table for reference.
weather.rubber_time_scale_*:
Set time scale multiplier for calculating rubber coverage in corresponding sessions (practice, qualifying, race). This value should match Realroad Time Scale session setting from game. For static rubber, set time scale to 0.

Note, since Realroad Time Scale data is not available from game API, it is required to manually set the value.

Most online servers use default 1.0 Realroad Time Scale setting during qualifying and race session, while some servers may use static setting during practice session only.
weather.show_rubber_coverage_while_dry:
Show rough estimate of rubber coverage (percent) based on total number of laps done by all drivers while road surface is dry.

Note, rubber coverage reading may not be accurate during practice session in multiplayer, as some API data will be lost or reset while people joining or leaving server. This does not affect qualifying and race session.

weather.show_trend: Show weather change trend for temperature, raininess, surface wetness readings.
weather.show_wetness: Show average surface wetness in percentage.
weather.starting_rubber_*:
Set starting rubber coverage (percent) in corresponding sessions (practice, qualifying, race).

Note, since session starting rubber coverage data is not available from game API, it is required to manually set the value.
weather.temperature_trend_interval:
Set weather change trend interval in seconds. Default interval is 60 seconds.

If weather readings increased within the interval, ▲ uparrow sign will be shown; if readings decreased within the interval, ▼ downarrow sign will be shown; If readings has not changed during the interval, ● sign will be shown after.
weather.wetness_trend_interval:
Set weather change trend interval in seconds. Default interval is 60 seconds.

If weather readings increased within the interval, ▲ uparrow sign will be shown; if readings decreased within the interval, ▼ downarrow sign will be shown; If readings has not changed during the interval, ● sign will be shown after.

weather_forecast.number_of_forecasts: Set number of forecasts to display. Value range in 1 to 4. Default is 4 forecasts.
weather_forecast.show_ambient_temperature: Show estimated ambient temperature reading for upcoming weather. Note, the now column always shows current ambient temperature instead.
weather_forecast.show_estimated_time: Show estimated time reading for upcoming weather. Note, estimated time reading only works in time-based race. Other race type such as lap-based race shows n/a instead.
weather_forecast.show_rain_chance_bar: Show visualized rain chance bar reading for upcoming weather. Note, the now column always shows current raininess instead.
weather_forecast.show_rain_chance_reading: Show rain chance reading in percentage.
weather_forecast.show_unavailable_data: Show columns with unavailable weather data. Set False to auto hide columns with unavailable data. Note, auto hide only works for time-based race.

web_dashboard.access_code: Access code required to open the dashboard. A random code is generated if empty. After 10 wrong codes, the device is blocked for 60 seconds.
web_dashboard.enable_https: Serve the dashboard over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, so the access code and data are encrypted on the local network. The certificate is created in the config folder and reused (a new one is made when this computer gets a new address). The browser warns once about the self-signed certificate: Web Dashboard Address... shows its SHA-256 fingerprint to check before accepting it. Disabled by default.
web_dashboard.enable_lan_access: Allow devices on local network (phone, tablet) to open the dashboard. When disabled, the dashboard is only available on this computer (127.0.0.1). Windows firewall may ask to allow Modern Tiny Pedals the first time.

weight_distribution.show_front_to_rear_distribution: Show front to rear weight distribution in percentage.
weight_distribution.show_left_to_right_distribution: Show left to right weight distribution in percentage.
weight_distribution.smoothing_samples: Set number of samples for reducing data fluctuation. Lower value may result more fluctuated reading. Set 1 to disable smoothing.

wheel_camber.camber_difference_smoothing_samples: Set number of samples for reducing data fluctuation. Lower value may result more fluctuated reading. Set 1 to disable smoothing.
wheel_camber.camber_smoothing_samples: Set number of samples for reducing data fluctuation. Lower value may result more fluctuated reading. Set 1 to disable smoothing.
wheel_camber.positive_camber_threshold: Set positive camber threshold for highlighting positive camber angle.
wheel_camber.show_camber_difference: Show camber difference between left and right wheel on the same axle, useful for quickly checking misalignment while driving.

wheel_toe.show_total_toe_angle: Show total toe angle between left and right wheel on the same axle, useful for quickly checking amount total toe angle while driving.
wheel_toe.toe_in_smoothing_samples: Set number of samples for reducing data fluctuation. Lower value may result more fluctuated reading. Set 1 to disable smoothing.
wheel_toe.total_toe_angle_smoothing_samples: Set number of samples for reducing data fluctuation. Lower value may result more fluctuated reading. Set 1 to disable smoothing.
